<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>Controlled by the pedestrian button, the motor vehicle lane indicator light changes between green, yellow, and red, while the sidewalk indicator light changes accordingly.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="pass_request">Request signal for pedestrians to cross.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">Internal counter value.</output>
        <output id="red">Red signal for the motor vehicle lane.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow signal for the motor vehicle lane.</output>
        <output id="green">Green signal for the motor vehicle lane.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="idle">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s1_red">State after red signal.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s2_yellow">State after yellow signal.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s3_green">State after green signal.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[7:0]">Internal counter for timing control.</reg>
        <reg id="state">Current state of the traffic light controller.</reg>
        <reg id="p_red">Next value for the red signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_yellow">Next value for the yellow signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_green">Next value for the green signal.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= 2'b0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    2'b00: begin
                        p_red <= 1'b0;
                        p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                        p_green <= 1'b0;
                        state <= 2'b01;
                    end
                    2'b01: begin
                        p_red <= 1'b1;
                        p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                        p_green <= 1'b0;
                        if(cnt == 8'd3) begin
                            state <= 2'b11;
                        end else begin
                            state <= 2'b01;
                        end
                    end
                    2'b10: begin
                        p_red <= 1'b0;
                        p_yellow <= 1'b1;
                        p_green <= 1'b0;
                        if(cnt == 8'd3) begin
                            state <= 2'b01;
                        end else begin
                            state <= 2'b10;
                        end
                    end
                    2'b11: begin
                        p_red <= 1'b0;
                        p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                        p_green <= 1'b1;
                        if(cnt == 8'd3) begin
                            state <= 2'b10;
                        end else begin
                            state <= 2'b11;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Counting logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 8'd10;
            end else if(pass_request && green) begin
                cnt <= 8'd10;
            end else if(~green && p_green) begin
                cnt <= 8'd60;
            end else if(~yellow && p_yellow) begin
                cnt <= 8'd5;
            end else if(~red && p_red) begin
                cnt <= 8'd10;
            end else begin
                cnt <= cnt - 1'b1;
            end
        end
        
        // Output assignment
        assign clock = cnt;
        
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                {red,yellow,green} <= 3'b000;
            end else begin
                {red,yellow,green} <= {p_red,p_yellow,p_green};
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
